newsitem.title: OMAN: Ship capsizes off Oman, one dead, several missing.
newsitem.headline: Ship capsizes off Oman, one dead, several missing.

text.p: One man was killed and at least nine were missing after an Indian-registered cargo ship capsized in the Arabian Sea, shipping sources said on Saturday.
The ship, carrying a 13-member crew of Indians, capsized on Thursday near the island of Masirah east of Oman after it hit rocks in bad weather, shipping sources said.
It was carrying construction materials from Oman to the island, they added.
Three men were rescued and taken to hospital. One body was recovered and rescue teams using helicopters were searching for any other survivors or bodies, they said.
Gulf news agencies earlier said the ship was Omani.
Omani officials were not immediately available for comment.
